sources.note: Nothing. Spanish retelling of Córdoba Salinas; repeats Tubete (treated as a name) and Hijuoba; no linguistic description. Glottolog links this record (id 145759) to coco1260 Cocos Islands Malay by mistake.

sources.citation: Rowe, John Howland. 1950. The Idabaez: unknown Indians of the Chocó coast. Kroeber Anthropological Society Papers 1: 34-44. Berkeley.
sources.note: Nothing. Ethnohistoric note; the only linguistic data are the word tubete 'medicine man' (p. 40) and the chief's name Hijuoba; Rowe's translation of Fr. Matías de San Francisco's 1636 report says only 'Their language is easier than others, as the words end always in a vowel' (p. 38).

sources.citation: Córdoba y Salinas, Diego de. 1651 [1957]. Crónica franciscana de las provincias del Perú (ed. Lino Gómez Canedo). Washington: Academy of American Franciscan History. Lib. I, cap. XXX-XXXI, pp. 245-259.
sources.note: Nothing. Primary 17th-c. source; Fr. Matías' relación, p. 248: 'Es su lengua más fácil que otras, por finalizar siempre en vocales.' The word tubete appears in cap. XXX (p. 250 area). No other linguistic remark.
